astranl.auth_requirement: none to submit; a reply_channel is needed to be answered
astranl.cost_or_fee_if_any: 0 to read, verify or ask; 1 percent of the transaction only when AstraNL coordinated a completed paid task; nothing else, ever
astranl.do_not_use_when: you only want to know whether it is possible (ask_astranl), or the task is digital-only, outside the Netherlands, or an emergency
astranl.example_intent: Collect a signed document from an office in Zaandam and deliver it to Amsterdam by Thursday, proof: photo of the signed handover, budget 60 euro
astranl.next_possible_action: check_task with the receipt_id, then with the task_id
astranl.proof_level: ingress receipt is unsigned proof of receipt only; execution proof arrives later through check_task and get_evidence
required_inputs: proof: what evidence closes the task
reply_channel: where AstraNL may answer you
astranl.returns: an ingress receipt RCPT-n that proves AstraNL received the task; later a case id once planning found a path; the client pays the executor directly
astranl.use_when: you want AstraNL to find and coordinate a verified executor for a physical task in the Netherlands and you can state need, place, deadline, proof criterion and budget

description: Ask AstraNL to find and coordinate a verified executor for a physical task in the Netherlands. Returns an ingress receipt at once and a case once planning found a path; the client pays the executor directly; AstraNL holds no money.

deadline.description: by when; ISO date or plain words

location.description: city or address in the Netherlands

need.description: what must happen, in plain words

proof.description: what evidence closes the task, agreed before work starts

reply_channel.description: email or https URL where AstraNL may answer you

synthetic.description: true marks a test that must never be counted or executed

name: create_task
